snippet.title: Married in Red | RPG Maker Horror | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Toxic yuri in my Studio Investigrave game? It's more likely than you think.

Game: Married in Red
Find the game here: https://racheldrawsthis.itch.io/married-in-red
Original creator: STUDIO INVESTIGRAVE/racheldrawsthis
Release Date: 2024
Engine: RPG Maker MV 
I do NOT own anything on this video, all credit to their respective creators.

If the creator wants me to take this down, please tell me.

Another Studio Investigrave game. The moment I saw it got released in my inbox, I started to record as soon as I could.

So... My thoughts... Are that I really enjoyed it. I like the fact neither of our "main" characters are really... good people. It's nice to not have blatantly good or evil characters. I just noticed it. 

The story is also interesting. It is interesting to play as the antagonist of a story, and I can get why she is the way she is. Do I agree? No. I just feel very bad for the groom.

This is an Investigrave game so the graphics naturally look good. This game was apparently for a game jam, so it's even more impressive. 

So... good RPG Horror game. I cannot write descriptions anymore. Uhh... Good game, really liked it,  Thank you for watching.
